name: BookyMooky
description: Managing your tabs with bookmarks them and other features like notes, auto-close tabs, daily grouping, layout toggles, etc...

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com; img-src 'self' data: blob: https:; font-src 'self' data: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com; connect-src 'self' blob: data: https:; frame-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; default-src 'self'
